name: @langwatch/dev-runtime
description: Contributor-only: the Node applications in one local process (dev:one, the default, adds the UI's Vite server; ADR-168).

scripts.dev: while true; do node --experimental-transform-types $(test -f ../../.env && echo --env-file=../../.env) src/app.entrypoint.ts --backend-only; code=$?; test $code -eq 75 || exit $code; done
scripts.dev:one: while true; do node --experimental-transform-types $(test -f ../../.env && echo --env-file=../../.env) src/app.entrypoint.ts; code=$?; test $code -eq 75 || exit $code; done
